sections.title: CHAIN OF COMMAND
sections.body:
Who holds what, and who to talk to when you need something.

Rank in ROC is a job, not a trophy. Every rank below is a lane somebody has to own. If a lane is empty, it is open.

fields.name: First in Command
fields.value: Runs ROC. Owns the brand, recruiting, partnerships with other factions, the server and the bot. Final say on standards and on who gets removed.

fields.name: Second in Command
fields.value: Deputises for the First in Command and can run everything Command can.

fields.name: Command
fields.value: The wider leadership group. Anything you would ask in public, Command can answer.

fields.name: Ops Officer
fields.value: Hosts operations and runs training. Sets the schedule, writes the briefing, records who actually turned up.

fields.name: Ground Unit Leader
fields.value: Runs the Ground Unit. Assigns fireteams and sets ground tactics during an op.

fields.name: Sniper Unit Leader
fields.value: Runs the Sniper Unit. Assigns overwatch positions and recon tasks.

fields.name: Something about an operation
fields.value: The Ops Officer, or ask in <#1542215050108997684>.

fields.name: Your unit, or a support role
Someone broke a rule
fields.value: Any Command member. Do not try to handle it yourself in <#1540826188094644438>.

sections.title: OPEN LANES
sections.body:
**Second operation host.** Operations should not stop because one person is offline. If you can run a session and keep people organised, say so in <#1540826188094644438> and Command will talk to you.

Unit leader slots open as the units grow. The way to get one is to keep showing up and keep people alive.
